study type: Cross-sectional study with a case-control comparison
exposure: Maternal immunization status (tetanus toxoid, Hepatitis B, influenza vaccine)
cohort: Sixty-eight mothers of children with Cerebral Palsy (CP) were recruited from a community-based early intervention and rehabilitation program in Shahjadpur, Bangladesh.
finding: Immunization among mothers of children with CP is significantly poorer than the national coverage, and the immunization of the children with CP is also poorer than the national EPI coverage.
